site_name: Stream Data Centers Chicago II (ORDB), 1925 Busse Rd, Elk Grove Village IL 60007
verification: The researcher's quote is confirmed word for word on the operator page, and the site match is sound. It does not meet the bar for a start year: the page says phase one commissioning was INITIATED in 3Q22, not that the building was commissioned, completed, delivered, or operating, and gives no completion or go-live date. The only other dated milestone is "In 2023, the site was fully leased", which is a leasing statement, not an operating date. So the page supports a start in either 2022 or 2023 and does not settle which; 2022 is the likelier reading (inference, not verified). No second page narrows it: the 8 Dec 2020 release is forward-looking only (construction to begin Feb 2021, early occupancy 3Q 2021, no street address); the history page lists "Introduces Chicago II" under 2021 (an announcement); the 10 Sep 2025 ComEd release refers to "Stream's Chicago I and Chicago II developments" as existing but gives no dates. I read the titles on Stream's news listing pages 1-6 (2019 through 2025) and found no commissioning or opening release for Chicago II; pages 7-8 were not opened (older than the site), and article bodies were not searched. The Chicago III page is password-gated and was not pursued. Pages were read through a fetch tool that summarizes; quotes are as the tool returned them. To resolve: a dated trade-press or operator item on Chicago II's commissioning completion, an ENERGY STAR registry entry, or a Cook County assessor / Elk Grove Village occupancy record for 1925 Busse Rd.

lead.year_evidence_quote: Stream acquired the site, and launched development in 2020, and initiated phase one commissioning in 3Q22.
lead.notes: Stream's Chicago page (undated, 2026 footer) says phase one commissioning began in 3Q22 and that the site was fully leased in 2023. The paragraph sits directly above the ORDB / 1925 Busse Road block, so the address tie is by page layout, not a printed address. Commissioning start is not an explicit operating date, so 2022 is the likeliest reading but 2023 is possible.
